## Tier

- [ ] Passive — reads what the target already serves
- [ ] Safe — ordinary requests a browser or client would make
- [ ] Intrusive — may be logged, may fail, allowed only with an intrusive scope
- [ ] Not a technique — CLI, report or desktop change

Destructive techniques are out of scope for this project.
